EIP-8163 proposed for Hegotá and moved to Review
summary_en: derekchiang submitted an EIP-8141 change relaxing mempool rules so accounts no longer need a specific factory. pdobacz proposed EIP-8163 (reserve the EXTENSION opcode) for Hegotá and moved it to Review. Ethereal news #20 came out, covering the rsETH recovery effort and Arbitrum freezing the exploiter's ETH.
